title: sme-default-attainability: code and results for 'Machine learning, attainability bounds and data value for small and medium-sized enterprise default reduction'
description: Analysis code, the SaudiSME-Sim simulator and the result files behind the paper 'Machine learning, attainability bounds and data value for small and medium-sized enterprise default reduction'. The scripts compute the ceiling on default inflow at a fixed approval rate, the identified set of the default-inflow reduction from accepted-loan data, and a Shapley value over data sources, on SBA National, Home Credit, Berka and the simulator. The public datasets are not included and are downloaded from their original sources.
